company_name: Zhangjiagang Parkson New Material Co., Ltd
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The company provides specialized packaging solutions crucial for semiconductor and electronic packaging industries.
summary: Zhangjiagang Parkson New Material Co., Ltd is a leading Chinese supplier specializing in antistatic, moisture-proof, and oxygen barrier packaging solutions for the semiconductor and electronic packaging industries. With 12 years of experience, they offer products like shielding bags and vacuum bags, ensuring high-quality standards through advanced technologies.
